review.posthog_relevance: Changes to the Marketing Analytics dashboard and Search Console setup UI, specifically removing width constraints and centering on section headers and containers.
review.reason: The supplied hunks are located in frontend snapshot and implementation files. P1.F1.H1 is a dependency hash replacement, which is a standard maintenance action. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 modify the CSS classes of section headers in the Marketing Analytics dashboard, removing maximum-width and centering constraints. P1.F3.H1 modifies the CSS class of a section container in the Search C.

This could affect the visual layout and responsiveness of the Ad performance section, potentially allowing it to span the full width rather than being constrained to a maximum width and centered.
